# telnyx_phone_number_jobs (Data Source)

The background jobs that release or update phone numbers in bulk.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_customer_reference` (String) Exact, case-sensitive match for the customer reference supplied when the job was created. Only jobs created within the last 90 days are returned, including for accounts otherwise exempt from job retention limits. Searches the stored job reference, not the current reference on a phone number. Multiple jobs may share a reference. Combines with the other filters and account ownership. Supply a single non-blank string of up to 250 characters, without null characters, using `filter[customer_reference]=yourcustomerrefhere`. Whitespace is preserved; blank strings, arrays, and objects return HTTP 422. An invalid filter value returns HTTP 422. The literal string `null` is matched as text.
- `filter_phone_number` (String) Returns jobs that targeted any of the supplied account-owned phone numbers. Values beginning with `+` must contain 1 to 20 digits after the plus sign. The 10-value limit is enforced before duplicate values are removed. Unmatched or non-account-owned identifiers return an empty result. Phone-number filtering must be enabled for the account.
- `filter_status` (List of String) Returns jobs with any of the supplied statuses. Use repeated `filter[status][]` parameters; scalar and comma-separated status values are not accepted.
- `filter_type` (String) Identifies the type of the background job. One of `delete_phone_numbers`, `update_emergency_settings`, `update_phone_numbers`.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort` (String) One of `created_at`.

### Read-Only

- `phone_number_jobs` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phone_number_jobs))

### Nested Schema for `phone_number_jobs`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `etc` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the estimated time of completion of the background job.
- `failed_operations` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phone_number_jobs--failed_operations))
- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.
- `parameters` (Attributes) Effective parameters saved when the job was created, not a snapshot of the original HTTP request or current phone-number settings. Update jobs include the saved update fields; emergency-settings jobs include the saved emergency fields; delete jobs include only targets. Absent fields are omitted, and saved false, null and empty values are preserved. Tags may be normalized to arrays; filter-created jobs contain resolved target identifiers rather than the original filters. Historical jobs with no saved arguments return an empty object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phone_number_jobs--parameters))
- `pending_operations` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phone_number_jobs--pending_operations))
- `phone_numbers` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phone_number_jobs--phone_numbers))
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `status` (String) Indicates the completion status of the background update.
- `successful_operations` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phone_number_jobs--successful_operations))
- `type` (String) Identifies the type of the background job.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was updated.

<a id="nestedatt--phone_number_jobs--parameters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phone_number_jobs.parameters`

Read-Only:

- `add_tags` (List of String) Saved add_tags for an update_phone_numbers job. Values reflect creation-time normalization.
- `billing_group_id` (String) Saved billing_group_id supplied for an update_phone_numbers job.
- `connection_id` (String) Saved connection_id supplied for an update_phone_numbers job.
- `customer_reference` (String) Saved customer_reference supplied for an update_phone_numbers job.
- `deletion_lock_enabled` (Boolean) Saved deletion_lock_enabled supplied for an update_phone_numbers job.
- `emergency_address_id` (String) Saved emergency address identifier for an update_emergency_settings job. An explicitly supplied null is preserved.
- `emergency_enabled` (Boolean) Saved emergency-services setting for an update_emergency_settings job.
- `external_pin` (String, Sensitive) Saved external_pin supplied for an update_phone_numbers job.
- `hd_voice_enabled` (Boolean) Saved hd_voice_enabled supplied for an update_phone_numbers job.
- `phone_numbers` (List of String) Saved target phone numbers in E.164 format and/or identifiers. Jobs created using filters contain the resolved identifiers, not the original filter expression. Stored identifier types are preserved.
- `remove_tags` (List of String) Saved remove_tags for an update_phone_numbers job. Values reflect creation-time normalization.
- `tags` (List of String) Saved tags for an update_phone_numbers job. Values reflect creation-time normalization.
- `voice` (Attributes) Saved voice settings for an update_phone_numbers job, using the public field names and nesting. Only settings present at creation are returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phone_number_jobs--parameters--voice))
